{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
# Since QA orders are not real, and refunded orders are not successful conversions
filtered_df = df[~((df['revenue'] == '999999.99') | (df['status'] == 'refunded'))]

# Check the remaining rows
print(f'Rows after filtering: {len(filtered_df)}')

# Check channel distribution
print(filtered_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print(filtered_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Compute conversion rate per channel
conversion_rate = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(conversion_rate)"}
